heroSub: One of the four Ruling Diamonds who came into being in Era 2A. Sibling of Grand Regents Antton and Reina.
personality:
Nightshade isn't very social, so not many people know what he's like at first. He's shy and has a massive case of stage fright, which isn't what the average person would imagine for the gem that's supposed to be running Homeworld. Regardless of how unfit Nightshade may seem for his own job, he does it effectively, and that's what matters. Despite this, he always seems happy when he is in public, and he's kind toward everyone in his court, especially his fellow Diamonds. Nightshade likes to take on any work he can if someone is struggling. After all, a healthy work ethic makes things go quicker. He can get upset like anyone else, but it isn't common, since he's a chronic people pleaser. Nightshade has appeared less and less in public over the years, yet his court and Diamond work always gets done early, as if he has nothing else to do.
When Nightshade is alone, he works for hours on end. He does take breaks, mostly to clean or reorganize his space. The silence makes him calm and uneasy at once, and yet he doesn't know how to socialize very well. So isolating is probably better, right? His Pearls are the closest ones to him, and they handle public relations for the most part.
purpose: Nightshade Violet Diamond is responsible for the empire as a whole and for his fellow Diamonds. He makes sure everyone stays on course, no matter how overwhelming the workload is most of the time. However, Nightshade can't complain, since he was made for this. He has eyes and ears everywhere, which helps a lot now that the whole of Homeworld is his responsibility.

images.title: Nightshade Violet Diamond
images.alt: Portrait of Nightshade Violet Diamond, a shadowed figure with fluffy black and lavender hair, round pale eyes, a soft smile, hands folded, wide sparkling lavender sleeves, and an eight-point star gem at the waist

abilities.name: Absolute Sciakinesis
desc: Nightshade can shroud a battlefield in shadow anywhere on the same planet as him, leaving his opponents to rely on anything but sight. He can also stretch, harden, and move the shadows that are already there, including the ones his enemies cast.

passives.name: Aura: Long Shadows
passives.text: While Nightshade is on the battlefield, the shadows stretch toward him. Enemies who are Far make their attacks with disadvantage.

spells.name: Long Shadow
spells.text: One target's own shadow lashes out at them, dealing 1d6 + MAG damage, even if they're Far.

spells.name: Cast Shadow
spells.text: Shadow falls over one target's eyes. The target resists with INT. If they fail, they're Blinded for 1 turn, and their attacks are made with disadvantage.

spells.name: Shadow Grip
spells.text: One target's shadow holds onto their feet. The target resists with SPD. If they fail, they're Stuck for 2 turns.

spells.name: Shroud
spells.text: Nightshade shrouds the battlefield in shadow. Every enemy resists with INT. Those who fail are Blinded for 2 turns, and their attacks are made with disadvantage.

spells.name: Lights Out
spells.text: Every enemy's shadow turns on them at once. Each takes 3d6 + MAG damage and resists with INT. Those who fail are Blinded for 1 turn.

abilities.weak: His shadows can't reach past the planet he's on, and a place with no light at all has no shadows for him to move.

abilities.name: Sleep Inducement
desc: Nightshade can make anyone tired, from a single gem to a crowd, and can solidify that tiredness around a whole group so they have to fight just to stay awake.

spells.name: Yawn
spells.text: Nightshade yawns, and it spreads. One target's next roll is made with disadvantage.

spells.name: Drowse
spells.text: One target resists with INT. If they fail, they fall Asleep for 2 turns. Taking damage wakes them.

spells.name: Lullaby
spells.text: Every enemy who is Near resists with INT. Those who fail fall Asleep for 1 turn. Taking damage wakes them.

spells.name: Deep Sleep
spells.text: Requires a target who is already Asleep. For 1 turn, taking damage doesn't wake them.

spells.name: Time to Rest
spells.text: Nightshade solidifies tiredness around the enemy side for 3 turns. Every enemy is fighting off sleep, and their attacks are made with disadvantage.

abilities.weak: Anything that can't sleep, like a Gem Machine, ignores this power, and damage wakes a sleeping target, so his allies have to hold back to keep them down.

abilities.name: Smoke Mimicry
desc: When Nightshade gets too nervous or shy, his form turns into smoke. He doesn't always mean to, but over time he's learned to use it.

passives.name: Nerves
passives.text: The first critical hit against Nightshade each battle turns him to smoke before it lands. He takes no damage from it.

spells.name: Smoke Bomb..?
spells.text: A Reaction. When an attack targets Nightshade, he gets nervous and turns to smoke. The attack misses, and he can move to Near, Far, or Behind anyone.

spells.name: Smokescreen
spells.text: Nightshade lets some of himself drift out as smoke around his allies. For 2 turns, every ally who is Near him can't be targeted by enemies who are Far.

abilities.weak: Strong wind scatters him. While he's in a windy area, Nerves doesn't work.

abilities.name: Witchcraft
desc: Nightshade practices witchcraft: hexes, brews, curses, and familiars made from her own shadow. It's also how she watches over Homeworld. Her enchanted eyes sit all over the planet and report back to her, which is how her work always gets done before anyone asks.

spells.name: All-Seeing Eyes
spells.text: Nightshade enchants small eyes out of shadow and places them anywhere on the same planet as her. Each one sees and hears everything around it and reports back to her. Gems without a high MAG can't see them.

spells.name: Hex
spells.text: One target resists with INT. If they fail, they have Attack Down for 2 turns.

spells.name: Witch's Brew
spells.text: Nightshade mixes a brew on the spot and hands it to one ally. They heal 2d8 + MAG HP.

spells.name: Familiar
spells.text: Nightshade pulls a black cat out of her own shadow. For 3 turns, at the end of each of her turns, it pounces on one enemy for 1d8 damage.

spells.name: Grand Curse
spells.text: Every enemy resists with INT. Those who fail are under Pressure for 3 turns. They act later, and their spells cost more SP.

abilities.weak: Her spells have to be spoken out loud, so Hush stops her from casting them, and any gem with a high MAG can spot her eyes.
